items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: It’s really deep. Who was the drummer? He’s a left-handed drummer named West or something.

Charlie Smith is the drummer, right. Yeah, Charlie Smith. It reminds me if you will -- it reminds me of seeing Max Roach shake hands with Jimmy Carter. Max is looking at him like I should be a president, because there appears after all -- they are men of the same age. And black men and white men who come up through the same experience but also understand the different deck dealt with them, often I believe exchange things non-verbally, because there’s a protocol that says there’s certain things that you don’t say…
